title: View a paginated list of customer payment transactions
user_visible_behavior: so that I can monitor payment activity without opening each order
verification_command: The page shows order code, customer, payment method, amount, payment status, transaction code, and paid time; pagination works with at least 100 records.
evidence: Release build: 0 warnings/errors; integration tests cover pagination and 10,001-row p95 45.58 ms.

title: Search and filter payment transactions
user_visible_behavior: so that I can quickly find a payment by order, customer, transaction code, status, method, or date range
verification_command: Each filter can be combined with the others, the result count is accurate, and an empty result has a clear empty state.
evidence: Combined filter, summary and export integration tests pass; FE production build passes.

title: Open payment transaction detail linked to its order
user_visible_behavior: so that I can verify the payment context and amount
verification_command: Detail shows payment ID, order ID/code, customer, order total, received amount, method, status, transaction code, paid time, and a related-order action.
evidence: Role/detail API contract tests pass; FE payment detail and linked-order route build passes.

title: Preserve checkout and profile payment status behavior
user_visible_behavior: so that adding admin transaction management does not interrupt checkout
verification_command: Checkout, SePay webhook confirmation, polling, and profile order-history payment action continue to work for COD and bank-transfer orders.
evidence: COD, bank-transfer QR, profile unpaid-order, webhook replay/concurrency and underpayment tests pass; manual polling smoke is deferred to post-push validation by user approval.
